steps: Contact the Mukhya Sevika at the village level for assistance in the submission process.
Submit the application through the Child Development Project Officer of the concerned block.
Wait for the review and sanction of financial assistance.
Conduct the training program after sanction and inform the Directorate before commencement.
Submit the utilization certificate within one week after completing the training program.
parsed.department: Directorate of Women & Child Development, Government of Goa
